text:
maria: Heads up — CI link-check is flagging a fragment on the runtime KB page. Staging preview jumps to top instead of the H2. https://staging.kb.redwood/runtime/getting-started#Getting%20Started

kb-bot: link-checker: found 1 fragment-not-found -> /runtime/getting-started#Getting%20Started (line 42)

ali: I can take a look later today. Is this the uppercase-space anchor issue we saw last quarter?

maria: Sounds like it. Repro steps: open the staging URL above, click the TOC link for "Getting Started" — page stays at top. In the built HTML the heading id is "getting-started" but the TOC link uses the raw title (space + capital G).

sam: quick hack for a single file: replace the heading with an explicit id, e.g.
```
## Getting Started {#getting-started}
```
That avoids touching the build. :thumbsup:

julia: prefer a build fix if this is systemic — upstream slugifier should normalize TitleCase + spaces. But okay to hotpatch the page if it's blocking customers.

ali: I'll open a small PR to add the explicit id on that page and also add an owners frontmatter line so we know who to ping. Planning to run local link-check after.

ali: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/54321 — changes in docs/kb/runtime/getting-started.md: add `{#getting-started}` and `owners: docs` to frontmatter. Ran `npm run link-check -- ./docs/kb/runtime/getting-started.md` locally, no fragments reported.

maria: awesome, thanks. @julia can you review when you have a minute? Would like this merged before the next staging deploy.

julia: reviewing now. small nit: can you add a one-liner test to the link-check whitelist (so future weird title -> anchor cases fail fast)? I'll follow up with a tiny rule. :mag: 

kb-bot: link-checker: rerun on branch 54321 — passed (0 errors)

maria: perfect. merging after docs owner review. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

ali: merged and cherry-picked to the staging branch. Will monitor the next deploy and reopen if anything else pops up.
